Our Straight Rye Whiskey is 80% Dark Pumpernickel Rye. It is also balanced with Non-GMO Yellow Corn, Soft Red Winter Wheat, and Two-row Barley for a unique 4-grain rye whiskey experience. SPECIFICATIONS FORMAT 750 ml MINIMUM MATURATION TIME 4 years ABV 62.65% (125.30 proof) MASH BILL Dark Pumpernickel Rye Non-GMO, Open Pollinated Yellow Corn Ohio Soft Red Winter Wheat 2-row Barley CASK TYPES Toasted and Charred American White Oak
